AppEngine must copy this file byte-for-byte into scripts/fixtures/top-prospects-golden.json. soccer-fields is excluded because fields follows the facility word soccer. A stored denomination or NTEE X2 keeps a place name, a cemetery, or a Temple congregation with no non-Christian marker. Pittman Park, Labor of the Field, Knowles Chapel Cemetery, Morgan Baptist Church Cemetery, and South Whitesville stay. A name that ends in a congregation word stays even when it says Foundation, as do Foundation Church of God, Church of God in Christ, and Worship Center. First Church of Christ, Scientist stays. Jehovah's Witnesses and Kingdom Hall go; Jehovah alone does not. Funds, schools, camps, retreats, dioceses, and non-Christian bodies still go. NTEE X3 through X8 go. Beth as its own word, Beit, Kahal, Wat, Torah, Judaism, Shalom, Kodesh, Chesed, and a Congregation with no Christian marker go. Bethel, Bethlehem, and Bethany stay. Broadcasting, Emmaus unless the name says church or baptist, state council, for worldwide, and to the nations go. X20 and X21 keep Mission Inc, and keep Latter Day when the name says Deliverance.
